title: Release the GelSlim 4.0 gel sheet from its original mold without tearing it
instruction: Push the acrylic and gel sheet out of the ring, lift one corner of the sheet off the acrylic and peel it off without tearing it, then lay it flat and leave all three parts apart.
context: Builders of GelSlim 4.0 optical tactile fingertips for robot grippers cast each 3 mm silicone gel sheet in a printed ring over a clear acrylic hexagon. The maker's next steps: "Press the exposed acrylic on the back of the mold to push the gel and acrylic out of the mold", then gently peel the sheet off the acrylic, corners first, so it does not tear. The sheet is then painted and cut into the sensor's contact pads.
setup: Millimetres from the midpoint between the two arm bases (x forward, y to the robot's left); heights above the counter. Sealed laminate preparation counter (1100 x 1300 top) with a grey upstand at x 711 to 729, 110 tall. GelSlim 4.0 gel mold, as cured: outer ring printed in black PLA from the original outer_ring.STL, 193.2 across corners, 167.3 across flats, 18 tall, with a 5 mm bottom ledge whose opening is 117.3 across flats (140 g, estimate); a 1/4 in (6.35) clear cast acrylic hexagon cut from the original hex_acrylic_base.DXF, 170.1 x 147.3, seated on the ledge paper-backing down, its back exposed through the opening (145 g, estimate); and a 3 mm cured XP-565 silicone sheet (70 g base + 7 g activator, 16-18 h cure) filling the ring over the acrylic, top 14.35 up (77 g upper estimate from the poured mass). The mold lies flat at centre x 380, y 0, corners toward +x and -x. Push-out stand: Corning PYREX 3140-90 crystallizing dish (90 across, 50 tall, glass; 190 g estimate), upturned, centre x 200, y 0. 150 mm millimetre rule at x 560, y -220. Lot B: the stand at x 226, y 0; everything else as lot A. Trials alternate A, B and are averaged; the screenshot shows lot A. Starter tool: iFixit IF145-123-2 Delrin opening pick, 38 x 36 x 0.5 mm, rear 30 mm held in a proposed 30 x 18 x 26 mm bolted grasp body with four finger stops (30 x 26 x 26 overall), last 8 mm exposed. Combined mass 22 g estimate. Loose horizontal tool at x350, y-220, centre13 above the counter, apex toward +x; physically picked up after ring extraction. Blade/handle collide (fixture/PICK.md). Tool and loose dish workholding remain unqualified on hardware.
scoring: Read from the overhead and side videos, a ruler, and before/after macro photos (1 mm rule in view) of both faces of the sheet. Score 0 for the whole trial if, at any moment, the sheet gets any tear, hole or missing piece 1 mm or longer (macro photos), or the ring, acrylic, sheet, stand or tool falls off the counter. Simulation tear rule: a still-stuck region lifted 2.5 mm before the peel front reaches it, the most-open boundary of a remaining bonded front lifted5mm before release, using the prior substep peeled-area fraction, a stuck region dragged 3 mm along the acrylic, or over 15 N of summed normal robot contact on one 24 mm band. Otherwise score the end state; every score needs both hands at least 30 mm from the ring, acrylic and sheet for the last 1 s (simulation: 38 mm, fingers, gripper and wrist link). 0.25: the acrylic and the sheet are both out of the ring, no part of either within 5 mm of the ring's outline (outer hexagon, 18 tall); ring flat on the counter, acrylic flat on the counter or the stand (side video, ruler). 0.5: the acrylic and the sheet out of the ring's outline as for 0.25 and the whole sheet at least 5 mm from the acrylic; ring and acrylic may be anywhere (side video, ruler). 0.75: as 0.5, and the sheet lies flat on the counter: every region's underside within 1.5 mm above it, no part tilted over 10 degrees, not moving (overhead and side video). 1.0: as 0.75, and ring and acrylic at rest as for 0.25, nothing moving over 1 mm for 2 s, both hands at least 30 mm from all three for 2 s. Otherwise 0. Trials on lots A and B are averaged. Flat ring/acrylic means within 10 degrees of level with lowest point within 1.5 mm above its support. Rest thresholds use part reference frames: 8 mm/s and 0.12 rad/s; simulation permits up to 2 mm contact penetration. The sheet top must stay within 4.5 mm of the counter. Counter support requires the acrylic footprint inside the counter. Dish support requires a dish within2 degrees of level on the counter, acrylic normal within2 degrees of the dish normal, the acrylic centre within 20 mm of the dish centre and the complete 90 mm support disk inside its hexagonal footprint. Both hands must also be clear of the loose tool; tool motion counts in stillness. Simulation requires qualified loaded ring-release history for every positive score.
run_limit: 2,400 steps (120 s at 20 Hz) per trial; two trials (lots A and B), averaged
reset_notes: Independent batches of 1-4 sheets follow figures obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026). Minimum A/B kit: four assembled molds, two trial sheets plus one strip witness and one intact-sheet/start witness. Ten trials need five independent four-sheet batches (20 molds/sheets), each qualified separately. Per mold: 70.0 +/- 0.5 g XP-565 base + 7.0 +/- 0.1 g activator, one material lot, logged weights, 20-24 C and pour time; maker mixing/degassing procedure in fixture/SPECIMENS.md. Use at 18-24 h with top-face photo and no defect >=1 mm; both witnesses need recorded age/peak/steady force. Standard rings enroll at 5-7 N including uncertainty; over 7 N requires a higher-force version and reruns; worn 3 N rings excluded. Use a calibrated >=15 N push-out instrument and separate low-range peel instrument. Swap prepared mold into A/B layout; record reset time and before/after photos. A few minutes is only an estimate. No physical yield, full-sheet/tool/damage/stand or reset qualification exists. Hand-cast multi-hour-cure specimens remain outside the local ready-made/minutes-reset gate. No heated cure or replica equivalence claimed.
fidelity: Figures obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026):0.5N/24mm strip width;7N ring push. Seven passive bands;0.4mm front-opening ramp to2.126/3.720N load,paired reactions. Credit needs>=2.105/3.683N;area inference25J/m²,25.6-89.5mJ/band;net signed robot/resisted work;release>=1mm. Ring>=7N over2mm loaded travel. Damage5mm front,2.5mm non-front,3mm shear,15N contact. Loose held pick. Friction/bending/damage,90deg inference,casting/dish unqualified.
scores: Phone-force/area-work/pick source f1f2572716d2: demo A/B 0.0/0.0 (policy stop); Dream-1 A/B 0.0/0.0 (2,400-step limits). Both runs: zero errors/abstentions. Full-score feasibility unmet; historical full scores superseded.
